items.title: Bela Fleck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, December 7, 2004
items.q: Like I’ve got this trio I’m supposed to do. It’s Stanley Clarke and Jean Luc Ponty... we’ve never played together

ctx.x: That’s all right. You’ve got four dates to go and then is everybody looking forward to the time off do you think?

I think so. I think mixed, it’s like you never know, a whole year is a long time, you never know what’s going to happen so there’s always that wonder, you know, will we ever all be together like this again. But then again we’ve done it so much, we’ve played together so much so if something happened and for some reason it didn’t happen it wouldn’t be like the Flecktone experiment was a failure or something. We’ve done fifteen years. My thing is when we come back together I want it to be new and fresh and everybody…
So it won’t all be rest.
